acceptance: ChildAcceptance is _SingleWorker.delivered for the child: it fences the ISSUED offer against the four identities its own admission bound and calls public accept_offer with the bearer that offer minted and the child's own Work reference. PreparationExecution.offer returns the issued DOCUMENT rather than an id, because a callback handed only an identity could fence nothing. Nothing touches the parent's receipt.
